text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Aller Anfang ist schwer—all beginnings
are
difficult. That is why careful
preparation is
essential."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"This includes a perfect schedule, proper

follow-through, and..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to share with you the
timetable we
should follow for the next
three years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is what Eishin Flash, my new trainee
starting
today, says to me the instant she
steps into my
office.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The first three years after debuting are
the most
important to a runner and thus
should be planned
as efficiently as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since the dates and requirements of the
races are
fixed, it is only natural to plan
for them in
advance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I already have a clear standard
for which
races to choose. As long as I
adhere to it, my path
forward will
naturally unfold.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Whether or not the race is worthy of my
pride as
a racer. In other words, G1
races—races that only
the best in the
world can run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to become the ideal runner. I
shall
achieve my dreams by taking the
classic path that
many have taken before
me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thus, my first main objectives will be the
races of
the Classic Triple Crown—the
Satsuki Sho, the
Japanese Derby, and
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown—runners far
and wide
dream of taking part in those
once-in-a-lifetime,
top-class races.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To embark on that path, I would like to
take on
the Keisei Hai following my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is so I can prepare for the Satsuki
Sho, of
course, as both races are the
same distance and
take place on the
same track.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, since the race happens in
January, it
will allow us plenty of time to
recalibrate for the
Satsuki Sho should
any issues arise.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby comes after the
Satsuki Sho.
It boasts a celebrated
history, and receiving the
title of Derby
champion is a great honor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even Student Council President Symboli
Rudolf
speaks of her Derby experience
from time to
time. I want to experience it
for myself, no matter
what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka Sho will be the
year-end Arima
Kinen. Though fan votes
are required to qualify
for it, I would like
to set it as one of my goals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In my senior year, I'd like to win two of
the Big
Eight—the spring and autumn
Tenno Sho, as well
as the international
invitational Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would like to take part in
the Osaka
Hai and Takarazuka Kinen,
then, finally, run once
more in the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I can complete this schedule within the
next
three years, then I will have
fulfilled a perfect run,
so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her jam-packed schedule leaves me
speechless.
She's planning to run in
nearly every race that the
conventional
path includes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I understand how overly optimistic this
schedule
is. This is everything I have
been planning up until
now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But from this point on, I'll need your
strength to
succeed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want you to train me to the point
that this
schedule becomes realistically
achievable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am aware of my own limitations. I
cannot
realize these dreams on my own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is why I sought your help. Please
train me to
become the perfect version
of myself, one worthy
of executing this
perfect plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To me, promises are eternally binding.
So tell
me—can you promise me
something here and
now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Can you promise to guide me through
each and
every race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from the look in her eyes that
her mind
is set. But there's something I
have to know
before I can answer her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has talked a lot about what she
"should" do,
but I'm not sure if this is
what she really wants for
herself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Without question. My heart yearns to
achieve
these heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still a little wary of her phrasing, but
as long
as she is thinking for herself and
wants to move
forward, then...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Great... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What is it? I can consider it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you implying that there's a
possibility I won't
be able to run in some
of the races I listed,
depending on your
discretion?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'll do everything I can to
ensure she
can run the races she wants,
but if things go awry,
I want to be the
one to handle them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also tell her that she may have to run
races that
aren't on her list if I feel it's
necessary, though I'll
always be sure to
consult her first.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I shall follow your guidance
under
those circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I would like to keep
unforeseen
changes to an absolute
minimum and follow the
schedule as
closely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying that I strive for
victory, but
I'm against setting a goal
that strict.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The reason being that if I fail to win, it
will lead to
unforeseen changes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? More importantly, let's
start
discussing the specifics of my
schedule now that
I've laid it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we iron out the details leading up
to her
debut, I walk Eishin Flash back to
her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The schedule, you mean? Yes, it is my
creation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all. Compared to my parents, I
still have
much to improve on.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My mother thoroughly prepares and
meets her
goals with flawless precision,
and the first plan my
father created to
open a bakery was a resounding
success.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For me to have any hope of completing
this
perfect schedule, I must become the
perfect
version of myself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her soft words fall away as she gets lost
in
thought. I try to change the topic
before things
get too heavy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Once I've done what I need to do, I'm
setting my
sights on retirement.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Why are you so surprised?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's a perfectly viable option should I
complete
my goals within these three
years. After all, my
mother's career only
lasted four.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At present, I intend to return to
Germany to assist
at my parents' bakery
once I've accomplished my
goals here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have the first ten years of that timeline
mapped
out too. Would you like to hear
it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You needn't worry. I am absolutely
serious about
what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will devote myself entirely to racing
during these
three years under your
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, I ask once again... Please guide me
through to
the very last race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I look forward to your tutelage.
